name: TA-Miners-Reloaded
title: TA Miners Reloaded
author: Stefan Berg
description: Continuation of TA Miners for Factorio 2.1 and Krastorio 2. Original mod "TA Miners" by Texugo Maldito, ported to Factorio 1.1 and 2.0 by Wip-Sama. Big miners inspired by the Total Annihilation metal extractors: adds 3 tiers of massive miners that can mine entire ore patches.
